stages.title: Advanced vocabulary and terminology
stages.hook: Greek abstract nouns often end in -ότητα. How is "δυνατότητα" built from "δυνατός"?
explain: Abstract vocabulary is often made with suffixes. The ending -ότητα forms quality nouns from adjectives: δυνατός (possible, strong) gives δυνατότητα (possibility), σοβαρός gives σοβαρότητα (seriousness). The ending -ση or -σμός forms nouns from verbs: ανάλυση (analysis) from αναλύω.

Words such as ευθύνη (responsibility), επίτευγμα (achievement), συνθήκη (condition), συνέπεια (consequence), τάση (trend), επιρροή (influence) and προϋπόθεση (prerequisite) belong to a more formal register. Επίκαιρος means topical; it is not the same as English "epic".
stages.mnemonic: -ότητα is the quality maker: δυνατός becomes δυνατότητα.
sentences: This has a great influence on society.
We must take all conditions into account.

gq.q: Which noun comes from the adjective δυνατός?
gq.why: The suffix -ότητα forms nouns of quality from adjectives.

o: Epic, as in a long poem
gq.why: It is a false friend of "epic".

panel.q: Why are many Greek abstract nouns similar to English ones?
o: Greek borrowed all of its abstract words from modern English
English scientific vocabulary borrowed many Greek roots
panel.why: Words like analysis and crisis come from Greek.

panel.q: Which pair shows a register contrast?
panel.why: The choice of verb changes the tone.

panel.q: Why is it useful to study word families?
o: Families are always spelled the same in every language
One root links several words, widening vocabulary

teach.model: Abstract nouns are made with suffixes such as -ότητα from adjectives and -ση from verbs. They are typical of a formal register. Watch out for false friends like επίκαιρος.

trip.prompt: Find examples of Greek suffixes and make three new nouns.

stages.title: Academic language
stages.hook: In academic Greek the passive voice is common. How do you say "the data were analysed"?
explain: Academic Greek prefers an impersonal style. The passive often ends in -θηκε or -θηκαν: Τα δεδομένα αναλύθηκαν προσεκτικά (The data were analysed carefully). It avoids "I" and shifts focus to results.

Key terms are έρευνα (research), υπόθεση (hypothesis), μέθοδος (method), δεδομένα (data), ανάλυση (analysis) and πηγή (source). Cite with Σύμφωνα με... (According to...) and Κατά τον συγγραφέα... (According to the author...). Make a cautious claim with Μπορούμε να υποθέσουμε ότι... (We may suppose that...).
sentences: The author claims that the method is effective.

gq.q: Which verb form is passive and past?
gq.why: The ending -θηκαν marks the past passive plural.

panel.q: Why does academic writing prefer the passive?
o: It focuses on actions and results rather than the writer

panel.q: What does Μπορούμε να υποθέσουμε achieve?
o: It gives a clear order to the reader
It presents a claim with caution

panel.q: Why is δεδομένα neuter plural?
o: It is a plural noun from the verb meaning "to give"

teach.model: Academic Greek uses impersonal and passive forms: Τα δεδομένα αναλύθηκαν. Key terms are έρευνα, υπόθεση, μέθοδος and ανάλυση. Hedge with Μπορούμε να υποθέσουμε ότι...

points.ask: How do I make careful claims?

trip.prompt: Find a Greek abstract and mark the passive verbs.

stages.title: Professional communication
stages.hook: How would you ask a company in Greek to consider your application?
explain: Professional Greek is polite and clear. For a job write a βιογραφικό (CV) and a short letter: Σας παρακαλώ να εξετάσετε την αίτησή μου (I ask you to consider my application). An interview is a συνέντευξη.

At work, meetings (συσκέψεις) have deadlines (προθεσμίες). Useful phrases are Σχετικά με... (regarding), Σύμφωνα με τη σύμβαση (according to the contract) and Συνημμένα θα βρείτε... (Attached you will find...). Open e-mails with Αγαπητέ κύριε... or Αξιότιμη κυρία... and close with Με εκτίμηση.
stages.mnemonic: Σας παρακαλώ να: the formal key to a request.
sentences: I ask you to consider my application.

gq.q: Which opening fits a formal e-mail to a manager?
gq.why: It is a formal and respectful opening.

gq.q: What does Συνημμένα mean in an e-mail?

panel.q: Why is Σας παρακαλώ να εξετάσετε more suitable than Εξετάστε την αίτησή μου?
o: It is a formal polite request, not a command

panel.q: Which register is best for a team chat with a colleague you know well?
o: Informal and short, e.g. Γεια, δες το αρχείο
Με εκτίμηση και σεβασμό, ο υπογράφων Νίκος Π.
Σας ευχαριστώ για την προσοχή σας
panel.why: Register should match the relationship and channel.

panel.q: Why is a βιογραφικό short?
o: Greek has no words for such long documents
Readers scan it quickly for key facts

teach.model: Use formal formulas: Σας παρακαλώ να..., Συνημμένα and Με εκτίμηση. Keep a polite register, mention deadlines clearly and use phrases like Σύμφωνα με.

points.ask: How do I make a formal request?
How do I start and end an e-mail?

trip.prompt: Look at a model CV and list the sections.

stages.title: Literary analysis
stages.hook: The word "irony" is Greek. What did the Greek word ειρωνεία first mean?
explain: Literary analysis names devices: μεταφορά (metaphor), σύμβολο (symbol), σύγκρουση (conflict), αφηγητής (narrator), δομή (structure), ειρωνεία (irony) and υπονοούμενο (implication). Ειρωνεία first meant pretending to know less than you do, and it gives English "irony".

In Cavafy's poem Περιμένοντας τους βαρβάρους a city waits for barbarians, and at the end it learns that they are not coming; the last line says that those people were "a kind of solution", an ironic ending. Elytis celebrates the light and sea of the Aegean, and in Kazantzakis' novel the free-spirited Zorba contrasts with the bookish narrator.
stages.mnemonic: The barbarians never come, and the city is left with its own questions.
sentences: The narrator speaks in the first person.
Irony gives depth to the text.

gq.q: What is notable about the ending of Cavafy's Περιμένοντας τους βαρβάρους?
o: It is ironic: the barbarians were "a kind of solution"
gq.why: The ending reveals that waiting for the enemy had given the city a purpose.

gq.q: Where does the word irony come from?
gq.why: English took it via Latin from Greek.

panel.q: What is the effect of an ironic ending?
o: It makes the reader reconsider what was said earlier
panel.why: Irony works through contrast between expectation and outcome.

panel.q: Why does a first-person narrator limit what we know?
o: It removes all the other characters from the story
We see only what that narrator knows and feels
panel.why: Narrative point of view shapes understanding.

panel.q: What does Elytis often celebrate in his poems?
o: The light, sea and nature of the Aegean
panel.why: His poetry is known for Aegean imagery.

teach.model: Name devices such as μεταφορά, σύμβολο, σύγκρουση and ειρωνεία. In Cavafy's Περιμένοντας τους βαρβάρους the ending is ironic. The narrator's point of view shapes the story.

trip.prompt: Read the summary of the poem and note its ending.

stages.title: Advanced listening comprehension
stages.hook: In Greek, σε αγαπώ is written σ' αγαπώ. What happens to the word σε?
explain: Advanced listening means following the gist (ουσία) first and details (λεπτομέρειες) next. In connected speech, short words can lose a final vowel: σε αγαπώ becomes σ' αγαπώ, with an apostrophe in writing. This is elision.

Speakers use pauses (παύσεις) and tempo (ρυθμός) to organise meaning. Tongue twisters (γλωσσοδέτες) train difficult sound sequences. Listen for the stressed words first; the accent shows where the main sound falls in each word, but in fast speech you must catch it by ear.
stages.mnemonic: Σε + αγαπώ meet and shake hands: σ' αγαπώ.
sentences: He speaks at a fast tempo.

o: The vowel of σε is dropped (elision)
A new letter is added to the end of σε

gq.q: What is a good first step when listening to a fast speaker?
o: Write down every single sound you hear
Catch the gist and the stressed words
Stop at the first unknown word

panel.q: Why do learners misunderstand spoken forms they know in writing?
o: Elision and merging make speech differ from the spelling

panel.q: Why is stress important when listening?
o: It points to the key words and distinguishes similar words

panel.q: What do tongue twisters train?
o: Fast, accurate articulation of difficult sound sequences

teach.model: First catch the gist, then the details. In fast speech short words are elided: σε αγαπώ becomes σ' αγαπώ. Listen for stress and pauses.

trip.prompt: Find examples of elision in Greek and read them aloud.

stages.title: Oral fluency and presentations
stages.hook: Which Greek expressions help you keep speaking when you lose the thread?
explain: Fluent speakers use discourse phrases. Με άλλα λόγια (in other words) restates, Όσον αφορά (as regards) shifts the topic, Όπως είπα πριν (as I said before) refers back, and Συνοψίζοντας (summing up) closes. Όσον αφορά is followed by the accusative: Όσον αφορά την τιμή.

Συνοψίζοντας is a gerund (μετοχή) ending in -οντας, an invariable form that expresses an accompanying action. To stay fluent, pause calmly, avoid too many fillers like δηλαδή or ε, and use rising and falling intonation to mark ideas.
stages.mnemonic: Signposts keep speaker and listener on the road.
items: Let us move to the next topic.
sentences: In other words, it is impossible.
As regards the price, it is high.
Summing up, I will say the following.

o: Genitive plural: όσον αφορά των τιμών
gq.why: The phrase is followed by the accusative.

o: A noun meaning the final summary

panel.q: Why do speakers say με άλλα λόγια?
o: To restate an idea so the listener understands

panel.q: What is a risk of too many fillers?
o: The speech sounds hesitant and loses force

panel.q: Which strategy supports fluency?
o: Never pausing, so you do not lose time

teach.model: Use signposts: με άλλα λόγια, όσον αφορά, όπως είπα πριν and συνοψίζοντας. Όσον αφορά takes the accusative. Use pauses and intonation, and avoid too many fillers.

trip.prompt: Watch a short talk and note two signpost phrases.

stages.title: Translation and interpretation
stages.hook: Greek is one of the official languages of the European Union. Who makes sure texts exist in Greek?
explain: Translation (μετάφραση) works with written text and time to revise. Interpretation (διερμηνεία) is live: διαδοχική (consecutive) waits for the speaker to pause, and ταυτόχρονη (simultaneous) follows the speaker with a delay of a few seconds. Both need concentration, terminology (ορολογία) and quick decisions.

A calque, called μεταφραστικό δάνειο in Greek, copies a foreign structure word for word and often sounds unnatural. Skilled translators keep the nuance (απόχρωση) and register. Ethics matter: fidelity to meaning, neutrality and confidentiality. Greek is an official language of the EU, which employs many Greek translators and interpreters.
stages.mnemonic: Consecutive waits, simultaneous runs, and both carry meaning.

o: The interpreter speaks at the same time as the speaker
The interpreter speaks after the speaker pauses
The interpreter repeats the same sentence
A word-for-word copy of a foreign structure

panel.q: Why is confidentiality part of an interpreter's ethics?
o: Interpreters hear private or sensitive information

panel.q: What does a translator do when a term has no direct equivalent?
o: Chooses a clear explanation or accepted term and stays consistent

panel.q: Why are glossaries prepared before simultaneous interpreting?
o: Speakers read the glossaries aloud to the audience
There is little time to search for terms live

teach.model: Translators work with written text; interpreters work live. Consecutive interpreting follows pauses, and simultaneous interpreting runs a few seconds behind. Avoid calques and keep terminology consistent.

points.ask: What types of interpreting are there?

trip.prompt: Read about modes of interpretation and note one difference.

stages.title: Idiomatic and figurative language
stages.hook: A Greek says "I put water in my wine" during a negotiation. What does that mean?
explain: Figurative language gives colour. Βάζω νερό στο κρασί μου means to compromise, Τα βρήκαμε means we reached an agreement, Κοντός ψαλμός αλληλούια means "to cut a long story short", Φέρνω τα πάνω κάτω means to turn everything upside down, and Δεν βγάζω άκρη means that I cannot make sense of something.

Others: Με τα χίλια ζόρια (with a thousand troubles) means with great difficulty, Έβαλα τα δυνατά μου means I did my best, and Έχω το κεφάλι μου ήσυχο means I have peace of mind. Idioms are learned as wholes, often from daily life, church customs and fables.
stages.mnemonic: A little water in the wine makes both sides drink.
items: to cut a long story short
I cannot make sense of it
sentences: We reached an agreement in the end.
I cannot make sense of it.

gq.q: What does βάζω νερό στο κρασί μου mean?
gq.why: The idiom describes softening one's position.

gq.q: Which idiom means "we reached an agreement"?
gq.why: Τα βρήκαμε is used after a discussion that ends well.

panel.q: Why should idioms be learned as wholes?
o: Their meaning cannot be derived from the separate words
panel.why: An idiom is a fixed unit.

panel.q: How would you translate βάζω νερό στο κρασί μου into English?
o: I meet someone halfway, or I compromise
panel.why: A good translation keeps the meaning.

panel.q: Which context fits Με τα χίλια ζόρια?
o: Finishing a very hard task after much effort

teach.model: Idioms such as βάζω νερό στο κρασί μου and τα βρήκαμε are fixed expressions. Translate them by meaning, not word by word, and learn each as a whole.

trip.prompt: Pick two Greek idioms and find English equivalents.

stages.title: Extended independent writing
stages.hook: A long essay needs a thread. Which Greek words make the thread of ideas visible?
explain: Independent writing needs a clear thesis, supporting paragraphs and links between them. Useful devices: πρωτίστως (first and foremost), αξίζει να σημειωθεί (it is worth noting), ωστόσο (however), ως αποτέλεσμα (as a result), με βάση αυτά (on this basis), συνολικά (overall), αφενός... αφετέρου (on the one hand... on the other).

Keep the style consistent and formal. Vary the length of sentences, avoid repeating a word, and check the agreement of articles, adjectives and cases. Revise after writing: check that each paragraph has one main idea, cut unneeded words, and check accents, which are part of correct spelling.
stages.mnemonic: Thesis, evidence, link, conclusion: one thread through the essay.
sentences: It is worth noting that the problem is complex.
On this basis we can conclude.

gq.why: Ως αποτέλεσμα means as a result.

panel.q: Why use linking phrases between paragraphs?
o: They show how ideas relate and guide the reader

panel.q: What is the purpose of revision?
o: To improve clarity, unity and style after a first draft

panel.q: Which sentence is more suitable for a formal essay?
o: Λοιπόν, ξέρεις, τα αποτελέσματα είναι κάπως έτσι και έτσι, νομίζω
Αξίζει να σημειωθεί ότι τα αποτελέσματα είναι αντικρουόμενα

teach.model: State a thesis, support it in paragraphs and link them with phrases like πρωτίστως, ωστόσο and ως αποτέλεσμα. Keep a formal style and revise your draft, including the accents.

points.ask: What do I do after writing?

trip.prompt: Read a model essay outline and mark the linking phrases.
